The '''Hall of Heroes''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Orotoru G'am]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The museum housed a statue of the warrior queen [[Nasrabi]] fighting a [[Keelkana/Legends|keelkana]]<ref name="Strongholds" /> as well as information and artifacts about great [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] individuals. A [[Orotoru G'am (track)|race track]] moved through it.
